mu_name_from: MuMain loads armour indexes 10 to 14 from ArmorElf{i+1} (ZzzOpenData.cpp line 149), so index 10 is ArmorElf01, which openmu's 0.75 Armors.cs names the Vine Armor. mu.db agrees: code 4106, group 8 index 10, Player/ArmorElf01.bmd.
why_this_one: The Fairy Elf's own first set, and the one set of the three that nobody sells: no shelf in Lorencia carries Vine, so this is a drop and a thing to look at. It is here because the Armour select had a single glove under her name and a set of one piece is a set you cannot see.
profile_from: Not armour, whose default is plate_steel: nothing in this set is a forged plate. See profiles/soft_armour.json, which exists for these three sets.

stats.note: The item's own row, copied from OpenMU's 0.75 initialiser rather than restated, with the call it came from beside it.
stats.from: openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Version075/Items/Armors.cs. The 0.75 table, which is the version this server is being built to.
stats.call_note: ArmorInitializerBase.CreateArmor(number, slot, width, height, name, dropLevel, defense, durability, strengthRequirement, agilityRequirement, darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel). `armor.Group = (byte)(slot + 5)`, so slot 2 is group 7, 3 is 8 and 4 is 9.
stats.defense_note: Points of defence, in the row and summed into Player.ArmourDefense by Wear - see shared/Rows.cs.
stats.classes_from: The last three ints of the call are 0, 0, 1 - the Fairy Elf alone. Sixty agility beside thirty strength is the row saying the same thing in stats.

sheet_from: Data/Player/upper_04.OZJ (128x128), hide.jpg and skin_warrior_01.OZJ (256x256), from MuMain. The .bmd names upper_04.jpg, hide.jpg and skin_warrior_01.jpg; 54 of the 154 triangles are on the first, 18 on hide and 82 on the skin - more of this piece is skin than is armour, which is the set.
sheet_note: upper_04 is a hide bodice with a scrolled vine raised down the breast and over each shoulder, the raised work in the same brown as the hide under it rather than in a metal. Mean (91, 63, 42) at chroma 48. skin_warrior_01 is the elf's own body sheet, which the piece carries because this set leaves a great deal of her uncovered and MU draws the skin as part of the worn mesh. hide is MU capping the openings, a solid black square, as on ArmorMale10.
material_note: Four islands, and more of this piece is skin than is armour. Island 0 is 72 triangles, which is upper_04's 54 and hide's 18: the bodice and its caps, leather. Islands 1, 2 and 3 are 25, 25 and 32 - 82 together, which is skin_warrior_01's 82 exactly - and take skin. The face and the bare arms take skin, not the profile's leather, and the islands split them cleanly because MU draws them on a sheet of their own: the three sit in the body sheet's torso and limb columns while the bodice sits on its own sheet.
